summary: Vista Energy filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of its acquisition of a 25.1% non-operating working interest in the Bandurria Sur block and a 35.0% interest in the Bajo del Toro block from Equinor. The purchase price was $712 million, composed of $387 million upfront cash (including tax gross-ups) and 6,223,220 ADSs representing Vista series A shares, plus $131 million in adjustments for debt, working capital, and leakages. The acquired blocks are consolidated as of May 1, 2026. Vista will update 2026-2028 guidance on May 11, 2026. No break fee or regulatory timeline was disclosed; watch for integration updates and production guidance.
